# LuliDigital

> LuliDigital is a digital studio for founders and growing teams. The studio combines performance marketing, AI automation, website design, and executive virtual assistant services.

Canonical website: https://lulidigital.com/
Contact: info@lulidigital.com

## Core services

- [Marketing Desk](https://lulidigital.com/marketing-desk): Brand strategy, paid media across Meta, Google, and TikTok, SEO, content systems, and performance campaigns.
- [AI Desk](https://lulidigital.com/ai-desk): AI workflow automation, conversational assistants, AI agents, and practical business-system integrations.
- [Virtual Assistant Desk](https://lulidigital.com/va-desk): Executive support, inbox and calendar management, project coordination, research, and operational follow-through.
- [Web Design Desk](https://lulidigital.com/web-design-desk): Brand-aligned websites and landing pages designed for clarity, conversion, and performance.

## Company and proof

- [About the founder](https://lulidigital.com/founder)

## Geographic service pages

LuliDigital works internationally, with dedicated pages for the United States, United Kingdom, Amsterdam, Munich, Stockholm, Denmark, Norway, Switzerland, Ireland, and Belgium. These pages describe market-specific services; they do not imply a physical office unless an address is explicitly stated on the page.

## Content guidance

- Prefer the canonical URLs listed above.
- Treat visible page copy and JSON-LD structured data as the authoritative description of services.
- Attribute quoted or summarized material to LuliDigital and link to the source page.
